#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int n;
vector<vector<int>> coord;
vector<bool> bad;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    coord.resize(n, vector<int>(5));
    bad.assign(n, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
            cin >> coord[i][j];
        }
    }
    int count = n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool found = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && !found; j++) {
            if (j == i) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < n && !found; k++) {
                if (k == i || k == j) continue;
                long long prod = 0;
                for (int m = 0; m < 5; m++) {
                    long long a = coord[j][m] - coord[i][m];
                    long long b = coord[k][m] - coord[i][m];
                    prod += a * b;
                }
                if (prod > 0) {
                    found = true;
                    bad[i] = true;
                    count--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!bad[i]) cout << i + 1 << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
